heard: Every AI product starts with a breakthrough. Then usage grows. So do the tokens, the models, the retries, and the costs. The obvious fix. Switch to something cheaper. But cheaper can fail quietly. A lower bill means nothing if the result breaks. That's why we built Zevchora. We map how AI work actually runs. We identify expensive paths, test alternatives, and measure what changes. We replay representative workloads against defined requirements. If the evidence passes, the change can be reviewed. If quality drops, it's rejected. If the proof isn't there, we say incomplete. No blind switches. No manufactured savings. Measure, replay, verify, then optimize. Zevchora. Make AI lighter.
